title: ExperimentComparisonRecord Contract
description: Comparison report for a bounded local optimization experiment (HO-01). The record binds one versioned experiment definition to exactly two runtime runs and their two behavioral-evaluation records, states the measured deltas, states what remains unknown, and records the decision against the declared success bounds. It is comparison evidence only: it grants no permission, promotes no skill, activates no runtime, replaces no approval decision, and never selects a configuration for adoption. FIXTURE_COMPARISON_ONLY is a comparison posture, not an activation state; the record carries no adoption input, no owner approval and no frontdoor admission, and therefore cannot be consumed by the promotion frontdoor.

definition_digest.description: Digest of the canonical JSON of the experiment definition the comparison was produced from.

changed_dimension_count.description: Exactly one changed dimension. A comparison that varies more than one dimension is not a single-variable experiment; the constant makes that unrepresentable.

routing_accuracy_delta.description: Candidate minus baseline routing accuracy, measured by the behavioral evaluation.

output_assertion_pass_delta.description: Candidate minus baseline output-assertion pass rate, measured by the behavioral evaluation.

unknowns.description: What the comparison did not measure. A comparison that cannot name its unknowns does not state its own boundary; the array is never empty.

outcome.description: The measured comparison outcome against the declared success bounds. It is a measurement, never a selection: no configuration is adopted by this record.

scope_note.description: The explicit boundary of this comparison, including which later slice owns the comparison it does not perform.

spec_digest.description: Digest of the canonical JSON of the run specification the run was executed from. The specification is committed next to the evidence bundle at specs/<run_id>.json relative to the artifacts base, and the validator re-derives this digest from that file.

evidence_digest.description: Digest of the deterministic projection of the run's evidence bundle. The projection covers EVERY file of the bundle and removes exactly the volatile fields — the wall-clock fields and the run-local identifiers that two executions of the same frozen inputs demonstrably differ in — and keeps everything else, so a change to the completion contract, to the interaction session, to an intent binding's rights transition, to the run events or to any execution output changes this digest. The validator re-derives it from the referenced bundle, so manipulated run evidence is refused instead of reported.

analysis_output_digest.description: Digest of the canonical JSON of the analysis output the run actually produced. The comparison refuses to report when this does not match the output the frozen definition materializes.

content_digest.description: The record's own content seal. A record edited after sealing no longer matches it.
